newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria arrests bartender who founded bank.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria arrests bartender who founded bank.

text.p: Bulgarian police said Friday they had arrested Hristo Alexandrov, a former bartender who founded a bank and funded a luxurious lifestyle in spite of its big losses.
"Alexandrov was arrested in connection with a case of substantial misappropriation of funds," a police statement said.

The central bank took control of the private Agrobusinessbank in November 1995 to save it from collapse, buying 90 percent of its voting shares for one lev (less than one cent). The bank reported losses of a billion levs ($4.5 million) in the first half of 1995 and 198 million levs ($892,600) for 1994.
Agrobusinessbank was founded three years ago by a group led by Alexandrov and Hristo Danov, both of whom served on the bank's board.
Local media reports said Alexandrov continued using his two luxury cars and a private plane after the central bank takeover. He spent the last few months in Switzerland, the papers said.
Agrobusinessbank was one of 14 Bulgarian banks placed under special supervision by the central bank to protect depositors and stabilise the crumbling financial system.
